bias.en: Bearish · rebound up to the SAR
bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹至 SAR 附近

read.en: Marvell rose 4.2% on Oct 27 to $243.57, trading between $235.23 and $245.81. It is above the falling 5-day ($234.8), 10-day ($236.6) and 100-day ($239.9) averages and the rising 200-day ($181.1), and below the rising 30-day ($254.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($246.49), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: Marvell 10月27日上涨 4.2%，收于 $243.57，盘中区间 $235.23–245.81。股价位于下行的 5 日（$234.8）、10 日（$236.6）和 100 日均线（$239.9）以及上行的 200 日均线（$181.1）上方，低于上行的 30 日均线（$254.3）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$246.49），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The close cleared the $236–240.6 resistance, now support. Resistance is $245.8–246.5 (Oct 27 high, SAR), then $250.1 (Oct 21 high) and $254.3–254.6 (30-day, Aug 27 high). Support is $236.6–239.9 (10 and 100-day), then $234.8–235.2 (5-day, Oct 27 low) and $223.7–226.5. A close above $246.5 would flip the SAR and target $250–254; below $236.6, $226.

s.en: Oct 26 low $223.7; Oct 16 and Oct 20 lows $226.5
